account: It is day 1, just after 13:00, and I am back at town hall for council letters, with the secretary nearby. Today's unusual news is repeated, vague talk of a 'bridge or port change' at the bakery. Several townsfolk have repeated it, but I have seen no such change and heard no clear firsthand explanation. The neighbour says they saw Builder give Baker a lantern and planks last night, but does not know why. I asked Baker directly before leaving for lunch and have not yet heard an answer. Those materials might be for lighting or building work at the bakery, but that is only a possibility; I cannot establish any connection to the bridge or ferry. Reports also mentioned the innkeeper carrying a sack of bread at the bakery, which could simply be bread purchasing. I went to the mill for the morning grain inspection but did not locate the miller; the neighbour likewise had not seen the miller that morning. Separately, a lantern was installed in the town hall yesterday, and I asked the secretary to record an 18:00 hall-lighting inspection today. I do not know whether that work is connected to the bakery supplies. My remaining appointments include tea with the neighbour at the dockside cottage at 15:00, office at 16:30, the lighting inspection at 18:00, and home at 19:00.
